study: Protocol B five-fold five-seed semantic-paraphrase reliability scoring

gates.audit_boundary_deviation: An overbroad mixed-manifest read exposed item-level IEMOCAP unknown-label mask fields in tool output. Standalone Evaluation/Test feature and label artifacts remained unopened. No statistics used those fields.

planned_condition.sensitivity_subset: Not sampled while blocked. Predeclare before inference and keep out of score selection.
planned_condition.eligible: Both predeclared reviewed versions pass semantic-label preservation and input QC and predict successfully. Preserve all failed versions with reasons.
planned_condition.review: Explicitly attributed AI and human review states and separately recorded automated QC.
planned_condition.context: Change only target text via the matching frozen RoBERTa. Retain audio, vision, Speaker, non-target rows, ordering, label mask and full Dialogue.

behavior_definitions.entropy: -sum p0*ln(p0), with zero terms contributing zero
behavior_definitions.JS: mean_k of Jensen-Shannon divergence between p0 and pk using the natural logarithm

planned_scoring.target: Original prediction is correct, original label mask applied
planned_scoring.fit_scope: Corresponding frozen Calibration only. Compare all arms on the same eligible rows; use the existing Fit-only standardization and fixed L2 regularization protocol.
planned_scoring.confidence_input_transform: logit(C) with C clipped to [1e-6,1-1e-6], matching the prior logistic scoring runs
planned_scoring.standardization: Fit population mean and standard deviation on the corresponding shared eligible Calibration rows only
planned_scoring.evaluation_scope: Corresponding frozen Evaluation only in an authorized completed run, no fitting or model selection.
planned_scoring.paired_bootstrap: Draw Dialogue clusters with paired scores across arms; carry all Seed records for a sampled Dialogue together within dataset. Record Fold and Seed summaries.
